description: Defines the EmployeeLanguageModel class, which represents a data model for employee language information within the OrangeHRM system's API. It specifies how language, fluency, competency, and comments are serialized and exposed via the API.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing EmployeeLanguage entity data for API responses, including language, fluency, competency, and comments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeLanguageModel with an EmployeeLanguage entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
